title: Termwise restriction preserves coherent formal objects
statement: Let X be Noetherian and I a quasi-coherent ideal, with Coh(X,I) and its object predicate as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For every open U and every F in Coh(X,I), the actual inverse system F.obj composed with the module restriction functor of [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] satisfies IsCoherentFormalModule for I.comap U.ι. The induced full-subcategory lift is the actual termwise restriction functor, not a chosen witness.

proof.text: On affine opens, ideal powers and multiplication images restrict to powers and products of the comapped ideal; they have the same local generators. Hence the ideal-power annihilation condition is preserved.

proof.text: Restriction preserves the cokernel defining each quotient. Compose the resulting canonical quotient comparison with the restriction of the given transition isomorphism. The quotient projection equation follows from naturality, giving the third object condition.

theorem coherentFormalModules_restriction_objects {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.Opens)
    (F : CoherentFormalModule X I) :
    IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap U.ι)
      (F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)
